notation: Illustrative abbreviated XML. Style IDs are local to each example. Comments and ellipses omit irrelevant payloads, repeated cells and wrappers. These excerpts are not complete executable OOXML packages.

cases.title: Content is not formatting
cases.guard: Keep zero, shared-formula followers and attributed value elements. Empty cached display is insufficient.
cases.risk: Deleting a zero or a formula changes workbook data.
cases.note: S4. Content tags are matched at their element-name boundary.

cases.title: Keep one font witness
cases.guard: A2 uses Arial 10. B2 and C2 carry Arial 18. Keep one needed font representative in this row.
cases.risk: Removing both witnesses shortens this controlled Excel row from 23.25 to 12.75 points.
cases.note: Native control uses a reduced 18 pt fixture. The corpus regression is Kulturfinanzbericht, Impressum!B16, Arial MT 12 and no applyFont flag. Its documented heights are 15 and 12.75 pt.
cases.bad: Delete B2 and C2: the following visible row moves upward.

cases.title: A witness is local to a merge
cases.guard: Retain one representative per encountered font in each merged area and row, even at fixed height.
cases.risk: Deleting B6:H6 changed justified paragraph spacing. A witness in another merge is insufficient.
cases.note: Destatis Informationen zur Statistik!A6:H6. Native controls reported 43,767 changed pixels with all blanks removed, zero with B6 retained. Original images are retained on another machine.
cases.bad: Keep only the text cell: paragraph layout changes.

cases.title: No fill can be a visible override
cases.guard: Row style 2 has a blue fill. The explicit styleless cells clear it. Keep every local mask, not one font representative.
cases.risk: Deleting K6 exposes blue at K6, even if L6 remains.
cases.note: PnP Sector Boilers, Fig 4 - SCR. An explicit XF with applyFill=1 and fillId=0 has the same guarded masking role.
cases.bad: Delete K6: inherited blue replaces the unfilled cell.

cases.title: Remove an override with nothing to clear
cases.guard: Style 5 applies fillId=0. No visible inherited fill or border exists and no other retention rule applies.
cases.risk: The same attributes must survive when a white or colored parent fill is present.
cases.note: Enron AUGUST, bundle 44ad86f1d9f249470fc6. The corpus case retained 21,947 unnecessary overrides before the fix.

cases.title: An implicit row style still overrides
cases.guard: customFormat=1 without s applies row XF 0. A gray cell may restore a column fill that the row format cancels.
cases.risk: Removing F187 because it matches the column exposes the row no-fill format.
cases.note: Raw Data F187:F190 is an independently restored Enron control. The AFFF manual Data rows 124-128 motivated the current row-format guard.
cases.bad: Compare only against the column: gray becomes unfilled.

cases.title: Font witnesses cannot replace local masks
cases.guard: Hidden columns can affect automatic height. Preserve each mask that would expose a font absent from the original row.
cases.risk: A matching visible witness cannot stop a larger inherited font at F14 from affecting the row.
cases.note: Data.gov LCOE model, Installed Cost Overview. Documented row 14 changed from 14.25 to 15 pt before the correction.

cases.title: Move repeated formatting into the row
cases.guard: Reuse an existing XF. Require a visible fixed-height, unprotected row and proved inheritance. Dense route needs at least 1,024 occurrences.
cases.risk: A newly inherited fill, border, protection or font at a gap can change the workbook.
cases.note: The full-width test removes 16,383 empty cells. No new style index is allocated.

cases.title: Restore necessary exceptions at gaps
cases.guard: The bounded dense-gap route admits at most 64 missing columns and restores original formats only when the inheritance proof succeeds.
cases.risk: Promoting the row without an E1 exception exposes a new inherited font or fill.
cases.note: The regression uses gaps at E1, AD1, XFC1 and XFD1. It also checks a second cleanup pass.

cases.title: A cached height is not a fixed height
cases.guard: Do not promote an automatic row. Both ht and customHeight=1 are required, even when the proposed font is already present.
cases.risk: A historical promotion shortened Destatis row 105 from 12.75 to 9 points and moved the footer.
cases.note: verkehrsunfaelle-zeitreihen, 3.8_(1). Native repair matched the 1,358 by 1,327 original capture. This drawing is a guard summary, not exact output XML. The excerpt shows the absence of row promotion. It does not enumerate ordinary cell cleanup.
cases.bad: Add a row style on an automatic row: footer moves by 3.75 pt.

cases.title: A centering span needs every blank
cases.guard: Style 9 has horizontal=centerContinuous. A value or formula seeds a contiguous same-alignment span.
cases.risk: Keeping only G2 does not restore centering after F2 is deleted. A gap ends the span.
cases.note: Data.gov Fig 10_New 10-29-19. The native counterfactual restored D2:G2, not a single sentinel.
cases.bad: Keep one blank instead of the span: the heading shifts.

cases.title: Protection does not erase a font effect
cases.guard: Style 7 contains a font and protection metadata. Outside the protection-retention area it may still supply required automatic height.
cases.risk: Treating protection-only eligibility as permission to remove its font can shift later content.
cases.note: Enron 005d034f18d6dc340a2c had five one-pixel row-height changes. Active and inactive protection are covered by focused controls.

cases.title: Prune only a genuinely redundant fill
cases.guard: Column style 1 covers A:XFD with white. Tail row style 2 repeats that fill and has no remaining anchor. Check exact column overrides and gaps.
cases.risk: A blue tail on the same white columns remains visible. White fills also hide gridlines.
cases.note: Two Enron Feb cases ended at rows 486 and 485 after cleanup. Native white and blue controls matched selected original regions.

cases.title: A font alone need not anchor a tail
cases.guard: There are no values, visible fills, borders, merges, drawings or later anchors. Font-only representatives do not retain an otherwise content-free sheet.
cases.risk: The same row before later visible content can be needed for layout and must be reconsidered in context.
cases.note: Enron NOV, bundles 44ad86f1d9f249470fc6 and a8bd950dff33454721b5. Exterior blank-grid geometry is outside this pruning contract.

cases.title: A row header can clear column borders
cases.guard: Column style 4 has a border. Row style 7 has explicit borderId=0. Keep the masking row header, including when applyBorder is absent.
cases.risk: Deleting the empty header exposes vertical column borders across that row.
cases.note: Santavy Table Sup E motivated the initial-tail-range guard. No full row of cells is added.

cases.title: Empty row heights position visible borders
cases.guard: Visible column borders make stored heights of nonhidden tail rows observable. Preserve them even without customHeight.
cases.risk: Removing an empty height record changes the extent and segmentation of the visible borders.
cases.note: The ordinary tail scan and content-boundary shortcut share this guard. Heightless and hidden redundant headers retain normal pruning.

cases.title: Conditional ranges protect row layout
cases.guard: Keep layout through the conditional region. Remove unnecessary font-only cell payloads and unrelated later tail headers separately.
cases.risk: Deleting preceding row heights shifts the end of a conditional fill, even with no ordinary cell fill.
cases.note: RN17B-RN30 Volatiles. Unknown conditional scope conservatively protects existing layout through the final Excel row.

cases.title: Objects extend the layout boundary
cases.guard: Resolve supported drawing relationships and anchors before trimming row layout beyond the last data cell.
cases.risk: Deleting row 50 because A1 is the last value can move or resize the later object.
cases.note: Missing or unsupported drawing information is a remaining review concern, not proof that no object exists.

cases.title: Merge tail columns with font witnesses
cases.guard: This is a schematic equal-fill tail merge. Keep one original empty-tail column per font identity that replacement would otherwise erase.
cases.risk: Replacing every Calibri 11 column with Arial 10 shortened NLA data rows from 15.75 to 15 pt.
cases.note: Unknown styles, overlap, hidden columns, borders, uncovered gaps and crossing data boundaries restrict merging. Visible row borders also expose column widths.

cases.title: Hidden constants need deferred approval
cases.guard: Admit only a dense horizontal suffix of equal signed integers ending at XFD, with every source cell eligible. Any intersecting known reference retains the entire span.
cases.risk: Arbitrary hidden tables, short runs, gaps, text, formulas and vertical repeats are not admitted.
cases.note: 4,096 is a conservative admission threshold, not proof of user intent. Deferred deletion re-cleans touched rows and invalidates stale tail anchors.

cases.title: Translate shared references by axis
cases.guard: Translate relative axes over the follower range. Absolute axes remain fixed. Protect enclosing rectangles without enumerating every formula. In this example the protected input rectangles include D91:J91 and D64:J64.
cases.risk: Scanning only the anchor misses E64 and can produce DIV/0 errors after rebuilding.
cases.note: Destatis verkehr-aktuell, 1.1.5. Unresolved groups, dynamic references or unknown scope disable reference-sensitive deletion.

cases.title: A blank chart-source cell carries format
cases.guard: Retain the first explicit cell of a directly resolved chart series, including its original number format. Do not retain every blank in the series.
cases.risk: Deleting A1 can change a source-linked chart axis even though A1 has no value.
cases.note: Current format-anchor discovery resolves direct worksheet references, not named or dynamic chart sources.

cases.title: Whitespace can block text overflow
cases.guard: Default leaves optional whitespace-value deletion disabled. A space is a value and can stop neighboring text overflow.
cases.risk: Removing B1 can expose text in the next column or affect dependencies and row sizing.
cases.note: Optional profiles have separate reference, protection and layout guards. ASCII whitespace classification does not cover every Unicode representation.

cases.title: Metadata has its own predicates
cases.guard: Match a built-in alias and its prefixed counterpart in the same raw local scope. Keep names on different sheets distinct.
cases.risk: The current predicate does not compare formula bodies. This example must not imply general semantic equivalence.
cases.note: Calculation-chain cleanup separately removes entries for removed cells only when sheet mappings resolve. Unaffected styles, shared strings and binary assets retain their indices and content.

cases.title: Column widths position repeated borders
cases.guard: A surviving row border repeats at column boundaries. Preserve existing widths even at empty positions.
cases.risk: Merging the empty columns moves the repeated border boundaries.
cases.note: This guard adds no cells and is propagated across parallel sheet chunks.

cases.title: Compare font records, not just IDs
cases.guard: Byte-identical font records share an internal identity. Retain the required representative without preserving duplicates merely for different font IDs.
cases.risk: Different font records retain their independent masks. Other XF components still matter.
cases.note: Style and font indices in the package are not renumbered. No general visual-equivalence test is inferred.

cases.title: Unsupported input is an exclusion
cases.guard: The fast parser targets unprefixed Transitional SpreadsheetML. Check bounded root headers, then namespace declarations during the normal stream.
cases.risk: An unsupported or malformed representation cannot be treated as empty and rewritten.
cases.note: Ordinary default namespaces and drawing extension prefixes are allowed. Strict SpreadsheetML, UTF-16 and explicit core prefixes have separate exclusion guards. The namespace URI is abbreviated in the drawing.

cases.title: Prune stale chain entries by sheet
cases.guard: Only sheet 1 was processed and its C1 record was removed. Resolve chain sheet IDs through workbook relationships.
cases.risk: Do not delete a same-coordinate entry on an unprocessed sheet or when its mapping is unknown.
cases.note: This is structural chain maintenance. Formula evaluation and replacement calculation caches remain Excel operations.
